body:
> In order to fix it and not add a dependency to RN, it fallbacks to using the previous behaviour when not in DOM.

What about we do not add any dependency and assume people willing to build instantsearch with react native do have react-native installed? This is what we are doing for react-dom, nowhere we have "react-dom" as a dep (not in peer, not in deps).

So that we could keep the same behavior. Would that work?

Ultimately we may have three packages:

react-intantsearch-dom
react-instantsearch-native
react-instantsearch

Just like what facebook does. So we can add any peer/dep we want that makes sense given the use case.
